title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25O (Procedure for closing down an undertaking)

content.overview: Section 25O requires prior permission of the appropriate Government before closing down an undertaking covered by Chapter VB.
content.glance: Section 25O requires prior permission of the appropriate Government before closing down an undertaking covered by Chapter VB.
content.study: An employer of an industrial establishment to which Chapter VB applies shall apply for prior permission to close down the undertaking. Closure without permission, or in breach of a refusal, is illegal, and the workmen are entitled to all benefits as if the undertaking had not been closed.
